title: TeamCounters
description: A sleek, client sided Fabric mod that displays how many players are alive in each scoreboard team in a customizable HUD overlay.
body:
TeamCounters

A sleek, client-sided Fabric mod that displays how many players are alive in each scoreboard team in a customizable HUD overlay.

Features
Live team counters shows each team name with player count (e.g. Red: 40 | Blue: 26)
  - Fully customizable via the ModMenu config screen:
  - Toggle HUD on/off
  - Choose from 8 screen position presets (Top Left, Top Right, Center, etc.)
  - Drag and drop HUD positioning click "Drag HUD Position" to freely place it anywhere
  - Vertical or Horizontal layout
  - Adjustable scale (0.5× to 3.0×)
  - Background box with adjustable opacity
  - Toggle vanilla team colors or use custom color
  - Toggle text shadow
  - Custom format string (e.g. %team%: %count%)
  - Ignore specific teams by name (comma-separated)
  - Filter out spectators
- Live preview in the config screen see changes in real time before saving
- Settings saved automatically to config/teamcounters.json

Requirements
- Fabric Loader ≥ 0.19.3
- Fabric API
- [ModMenu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) (optional, for in-game config)

Usage
1. Install the mod and Fabric API.
2. Join any world or server with scoreboard teams.
3. The HUD appears automatically in the top-left corner.
4. Open ModMenu → click the button next to TeamCounters to customize.
